_source: the app repo's .agents/continuation-20261003/sprite-reconciliation.md (OSM API, measured 2026-10-03): minimum-area rectangle of each way/relation.
_qualifications: height_m is the project RECORD's figure (often the tallest feature: a clock tower, dome, spire or sails); height_osm_tag_m is OSM's tag (often the roof line). They differ for several pieces and neither was re-verified here.

long_m/short_m are the surveyed footprint. sizeM is what the MAP sizes the drawing by and is not always the footprint: the Golden Gate Bridge uses its 1280 m main span (published), not the 1949 m deck way; the Palace of Fine Arts uses 179 m for the whole drawing though its rotunda footprint is 67 m.
source_note carries each row's own caveat verbatim, including figures whose source is not cited (Conservatory height 18 m).
Photographic handedness and camera convention were carried from the record, not re-verified. Refresh from OSM when a piece is added; never type a dimension from memory.
Covers the 18 pieces surveyed on 2026-10-03. Pieces added later (six on 2026-10-04) are NOT here; tools abstain on them.
